references.text: The glory of the Lord filled the tabernacle so that Moses could not enter. This shows the same divine manifestation as in Leviticus 9:23.
The Aaronic blessing that the priests were to use to bless the people, connected with Moses and Aaron's blessing of the people.
God promised to meet the children of Israel at the tabernacle and sanctify it with His glory.
At the dedication of Solomon's temple, the glory of the Lord filled the house, parallel to how the glory of the Lord appeared to the people.
The glory of the Lord appeared in the cloud, a previous manifestation of God's glory for the entire congregation.
Ezekiel saw the glory of the Lord lift from its place, the same glory that was revealed in the tabernacle.
The glory of the Lord appeared in the tent of meeting to all the children of Israel.
Jesus blessed the disciples and was taken up into heaven, parallel to how Moses and Aaron blessed the people.
Describes the priests' service in the first tent and the high priest who entered the innermost room, connected with Moses and Aaron's entry into the tent of meeting.
